notes: scan053.N1. This handwritten page states conditions (23) for an ordered topological space partitioned by Xi: the relation space is closed in X_Delta0 squared, and each Gamma_ij is empty or the graph of a closed immersion Xi to Xj. It describes the resulting order on I and the corresponding inductive system, then tentatively claims that finite I with binary infima gives a colimit into which every Xi embeds as a closed subspace.

scan053.N2. The order and inductive-system correspondence is carried as background from the author’s setup. This isolated page does not repeat all assumptions on the partition or ambient topology, so a general proof of that correspondence was not attempted. The counterexample in N3 uses nonempty finite discrete blocks and an actual partial order, and therefore does not rely on weakening those local conditions.

scan053.N3. Targeted check of the final embedding claim: it is false under the stated finite-meet hypotheses. Let I have bottom 0, pair elements p_ab,p_ac,p_bc, and maxima a,b,c, with p_ab below a,b, p_ac below a,c and p_bc below b,c. Every binary meet exists. Use finite discrete spaces X0={*}, each X_p={*,t_p}, Xa={*,a0,a1}, Xb={*,b0}, Xc={*,c0}. All basepoints map to basepoints. Send t_ab to a0 and b0, t_bc to b0 and c0, and t_ac to a1 and c0. All transition maps are closed embeddings and all composites agree. In the colimit a0~t_ab~b0~t_bc~c0~t_ac~a1, so Xa to the colimit is not injective. On the disjoint union of the fourteen points, the union of the identity and transition graphs is a partial order: transitivity follows from functoriality and antisymmetry from the poset I. It is closed because the spaces are finite discrete, and each Gamma_ij is empty or a closed-embedding graph, as in (23). Thus the example also satisfies the ordered-space formulation. The quotient/coequalizer description is not what fails in this example; the claimed embeddings of the pieces fail. The author’s sauf erreur and the literal embedding claim remain in the transcription. Parent supplied the independently checked computational certificate audit/151_scan053_counterexample.json, with companion scripts/check_scan053_counterexample.py; the separate computation event is recorded by the main reader and is not attributed to the first-reader proof check.

scan053.N4. To recover an embedding conclusion, additional compatibility is needed to prevent an identification chain through other pieces from merging two distinct points of one Xi. Existence of the abstract meet object alone does not force its image to equal the intersections of images in larger pieces. This note diagnoses the missing control; it supplies no word or hypothesis to the manuscript.

scan053.N5. The dark upper number is the author’s 14. The pale lower-left 52 is another hand’s foliation. Both are visible ink and both are omitted in H. Converting the lower number from mspage to margin changes representation only, not C’s digits.

scan053.N6. Literal wording and punctuation are retained: Inf des deux éléments y existe, no comma after de plus or à l’aise, undotted inserted top at both occurrences, undotted ens, and undotted final imm. The earlier transition des imm. has a real detached stop. The abbreviated etc is followed by four points.

scan053.N7. The large left brace ends at the Xi-to-Xj row. The small right curly mark after constant comma is a separate local mark. The curved stroke before constant is the leader of inserted étale, not H’s opening parenthesis. One closing parenthesis follows de b; no balancing second parenthesis is supplied. No independent drawing or diagram is present.

scan053.N8. All seven cancellation sites and all five insertions were checked. The words indexé par un ens ordonné I. are live: thickening in indexé is retracing, not a whole-line strike. The current X in the final quotient is readable at medium confidence, but its extra triangular lower stroke does not establish a separately readable older glyph. No invented old Delta or illegible deletion is added.

scan053.N9. M0982 remains open. M0983 is resolved to the first reading existe at medium confidence, and M0984 to X at medium confidence; each decision field contains only its marked span. The unlisted C doubts inside cancelled en, ds, et alors/étale and les Xj/Xi are separately inventoried. None of those cancelled uncertainties is silently promoted to certainty.

scan053.N10. In the order formula the empty-set sign is a slashed oval, not a Greek phi. C varnothing and H emptyset encode the same empty-set reading here; their font choice is treated as representation, with no extra correction row. Capital Lim is an actual alphabet difference from H’s lowercase varinjlim; whether its lower stroke is an arrow or an underline remains open.

scan053.N11. Visual coverage: page layout once, each full-resolution half once, and every written line against both witnesses. Twenty-six saved crops were actually inspected. b06 and b21 were repaired upward for clipped labels/ascenders before their final readings, then inspected again. The parent independently reviewed all crops and those repairs. No OCR, external research or TeX compilation was used. The count of 25 written baselines includes the seven condition-block baselines and its inserted ou bien phrase, but excludes the other shorter interlinear insertions and the two page numerals.

scan053.N12. Refined conclusion established by the counterexample: a finite poset admitting all binary meets, even with nonempty finite discrete pieces and all transition maps closed embeddings, does not by itself ensure that each canonical map into its colimit is injective. The colimit remains the quotient of the disjoint union by the equivalence relation generated by transition maps. The failed part of the manuscript claim is the assertion that every piece maps by a closed immersion.

scan053.N13. Blind adjudication adds the actual comma in the later Gamma_{i,j} subscript while leaving the earlier Gamma_{ij} without one. It keeps the source-projection notation sigma by the earlier definition and the literal capital Lim. The contracted inserted étale/étle, cancelled ds/d and et/Soit, old Supposons, local à/colon, and small terminal punctuation are now explicitly qualified. The triangular extra stroke at the final X may be earlier ink, but its shared diagonals do not establish a separate readable deleted Delta or a definite revision chronology. No change is made to the mathematical claims or their checks.

second_changes.evidence: The whole (23) block was inspected. The def above the first equality has no independent accent; the nearby mark belongs to the previous line. The projection label is the closed oval with upper-right return established as sigma by scan046 (7a), not a newly introduced a. The left brace ends at the map row; the later constant line and its right brace are outside it in the final page. The blind reading includes that adjacent context, already transcribed. The cancelled shaft letters now explicitly admit ds or d; see b06.

The deleted de is clear. Over the thick map shaft a tall d stem and lower loop survive; the remainder is obscured, so preserve ds with d now explicit as alternative. The oval source projection is the same sigma established in scan046, and the following inserted étale belongs to the next line already present in the page.

The inserted word has accented e, a crossed t, a strongly contracted middle connection and tall l/terminal e. Etale remains preferred, but no independent a bowl can be separated, so étle is retained as an explicit alternative. The long curved stroke is its leader, not a parenthesis; constant is followed by comma and a curly brace.

The long surviving tail in the cancelled phrase favors et alors while its shorter étale alternative stays. The labelled connector has a blunt right cap and remains arrow/dash doubtful. A separate small horizontal dark mark precedes the closing parenthesis after locale; retain it as a doubtful period, with short dash also possible rather than simply omit it.

The whole order formula has a separate short descending stroke between the i body and the long j in Gamma. Add the literal subscript comma here; the earlier Gamma in (23)b has no separate comma. Both inequalities, unaccented def, the double equivalence and slashed empty oval remain.

A broad first curved body and one tall crossed t support et, but the cancellation covers the low middle so that the blind Soit proposal cannot be completely excluded. Keep et preferred with Soit as an explicit cancelled alternative.

The cancelled baseline has the long initial S, two p descenders and final low o/n/s bodies of Supposons, but the middle is covered by the strike and raised replacement. Keep the word with an explicit doubt, while the new raised Supposons remains clear.

The lower a body is filled and reduced almost to a small wedge, with a separate high stroke. À remains preferred by comparison with the clearer reduced a in b17, but a colon-like reading remains locally possible and is now explicit.
